variants.guidance: hint that the ending flips the situation, using a concrete detail from this story, without revealing it (e.g. 'The coupon in her hand is the best part.')
set up the viewer as the judge of one specific choice OP makes later (e.g. 'Decide if I should have stayed quiet.')
preview how far it escalates with one concrete image from later in the story (e.g. 'By the end, the manager was wearing my shirt too.')
ask what the viewer would have done at the story's key decision, naming that decision
ask the viewer to judge whether OP was wrong for the specific thing they did, in plain words (no 'AITA' acronym)
